description: Ministry of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine - Notify the Amendment to the Sri Lanka Nursing Service Minute, published in Gaz. Ex. No. 1837/08
reasoning: This gazette contains an amendment to the Sri Lanka Nursing Service Minute, which pertains to public service recruitment and performance appraisal procedures for nurses. It is issued by the Ministry of Health and the Public Service Commission, making it a public sector administrative matter related to service conditions and regulations, fitting Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes).
